_readme: Written by the Cowork laptop task. Board reads this every 15 min. Keep newest first: the 5 most recent original posts from each of Man City and Premier League, 10 total, interleaved by timestamp. 'time' is the post's UTC timestamp; the board renders GST.

posts.text: Dan Burn's son stole the show from the stands on Saturday 🫶

Matheus 💬 We understood right away, when we saw in the meetings, what we will face tomorrow. A very well-prepared and excellent team and we have to be at our best level otherwise, we will not get a good result.

Matheus 💬 (On Erling Haaland) He is very important. He is the second captain and one of the players who has been here the longest - he has won everything for the Club. He is a figure, his voice is always heard and he is a top guy. I am happy his leadership has been growing because he deserves it.
Matheus 💬 He [Enzo Maresca] has such a good energy. He knows the Club and the standards.
Matheus 💬 I am good, 100% now. It was my ankle the day before Arsenal. I had a tackle and it was sore for a while but now I am fine.
Matheus 💬  Sometimes players go and new players come in and we have to pass on the DNA and identity of the Club. They are happy to be here and it’s part of the process.
The sweetest of strikes from Vitaly Janelt 🍬
